note: Fuzzer writes input data to a file named d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8428e (MD5 of empty string) via fopen interception
init() calls read_config() which calls read_config_expand() with expand=1, passing the fuzzer-created config file path
read_config_expand calls glob() with GLOB_MARK | GLOB_TILDE flags on the config file pattern, populating globbuf.gl_pathv
When pattern ends with '/', __glob recursively calls itself with the same pglob, which can realloc pglob->gl_pathv inside the recursive call
glob_in_dir reallocates pglob->gl_pathv to grow the path array, freeing the old pointer and allocating new memory
After recursive __glob call returns, code accesses dirname which may have been freed by the recursive call's realloc of pglob->gl_pathv if dirname pointed into the old gl_pathv buffer
Heap-use-after-free: dirname is dereferenced after its backing memory was freed by realloc in the recursive glob call, causing the crash
